| # Object 0x1000 device type {#object-0x1000-device-type-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                                      |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The device type specifies the kind of device.

 

  Index           0x1000
  --------------- -------------
  Name            Device Type
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       UNSIGNED 32
  Category        Mandatory
  Access          RO
  PDO Mapping     No
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0x00000000

 

Structure of device type parameter

 

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| MSB                               | LSB                               |
+===================================+===================================+
| Additional Information            | Device profile number             |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   |                                   |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+

 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   This object default value is 0 and ASW can set value using API bds_canopen_setDeviceType
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
